extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: semi truck (conventional tractor + 40 ft box trailer), approx. 18.0 x 2.6 x 4.0 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 1.04 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the trailer 'semi-truck_trailer' is a separate object with its origin on the kingpin (rotate around local Z to articulate, move to uncouple); its 4 wheel objects are children of the trailer; 10 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll), the 2 front wheels also steer around local Z; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
